jobs.title: Sr. Account Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Board is the #1 decision-making platform. Founded in 1994 and Headquartered in Chiasso, Switzerland, Board International has enabled more than 3000 companies worldwide to effectively deploy Business Intelligence, Corporate Performance Management and Predictive Analytics applications on a single platform. The Board platform allows companies to achieve a single, accurate and complete view of business information and full control of performance across the entire organization.

Founded in 1994, Board is a privately held company headquartered in Chiasso, Switzerland and Boston, USA, with 25 global offices on five continents.

For our office in Zürich, we are seeking a dedicated, passionate Senior Account Manager who will be driving new business in Switzerland. Reporting to the RVP Sales/Country Manager, we are looking for a results-driven individual who will manage the full cycle for a defined vertical.

Responsibilities:

- Increase sales of software licenses by independent acquisition of new customers
- Manage and own the full sales cycle, including prospecting and qualification, contract negotiations, and closing business
- Meet and exceed sales targets
- Qualify and manage leads provided by the Marketing team to a successful closure
- Building and maintaining a pipeline of high-quality opportunities by leveraging Marketing team, as well as through outbound territory development
- Work effectively in a team environment to maximize revenue potential and ensure customer success
- Manage and drive multiple simultaneous sales cycles effectively
- Understand the functions, features and USPs of Board solution and be able to effectively communicate these to prospect and customers
- Build and maintain strong customer relationships at Management and C-level, encourage the search of new potential partners and the support to the existing ones
- Use Salesforce.com to manage sales processes and accurately forecast business

Experience

- 5+ years of experience in enterprise sales
- Experience selling CPM, ERP, or BI software solutions
- Ability to manage C-level relationship and Enterprise-level sales processes
- Strong technical aptitude to learn the Board software and explain complex solutions
- Knowledge of Accounting and/or Financial concepts
- Familiarity with Budgeting, Planning, and Forecasting processes, Business Analytics, Data
- Visualization, Data Management and Financial Reporting
- Crossvertical, chemical and life science field experience favorable
- A self-starter who works well within a strong team culture while independently managing his/her own work
- Proven ability to meet and exceed a sales quota
- Outstanding communication skills
- BS/BA
- Business fluent English and German are required, French would be favorable

Board International is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce.

Your personal data will be stored for as long as it is necessary to process the job applications that you submitted and for the provision of the service that you requested. Your personal data may also be processed for the fulfillment of the obligations provided for by law. Your data will in any case be deleted without unjustified delay once the aforementioned legal obligations have been fulfilled. Your personal data are collected and used by Board International SA and/or its subsidiaries that are located in the EU or outside on the basis of the appropriate safeguards provided by the European Regulation 2016/679. At any time you may request to access, to correct and/or delete your personal data used by Board International SA or by its subsidiaries for recruiting purposes.

For further question, please refer to our Privacy Policy at https://www.board.com/en/privacy-policy

jobs.title: Associate AI Engineer (6-month contract)
jobs.description:
At Board, we help enterprises plan smarter, drive outcomes and lead transformation with one single Intelligent Planning Platform. Trusted by thousands of leading organizations, over the last 28 years, we have designed our Product with enterprise planning agility in mind and the passionate care of our people as our main driver.

We strongly believe every colleague brings unique value to our whole organization. We collaborate openly and effectively to deliver results and celebrate our shared success, thrive on innovation and embrace a growth mindset to aim higher every day. If you’re a forward-thinker looking for the great next step in your career within an innovative and collaborative environment, Board is the right workplace for you!

We are looking for an Associate AI Engineer to join our AI Center of Excellence on a 6-month contract. In this role, you will work alongside AI engineers and business stakeholders to design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions that improve business processes and drive operational efficiency across the organization.

You will contribute to real-world AI initiatives, leveraging technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agent-based architectures to address business challenges and deliver measurable impact.

## What you’ll do

- Partner with teams across Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, Sales, and other business functions to identify and deliver high-impact AI use cases that improve productivity and operational efficiency.
- Understand business objectives and technical requirements, and design AI-powered solutions to address real-world challenges.
- Build, test, and deploy AI applications and production-ready prototypes using state of the art technologies.
- Design and implement AI-enabled workflows, including intelligent document processing, multi-agent solutions, AI-based routing, and decision-support capabilities.
- Support the end-to-end delivery of AI initiatives, from use case definition and solution design through deployment and adoption.
- Integrate AI solutions with enterprise platforms and business systems, including CRM, ERP, ITSM, marketing, finance, and procurement applications.
- Contribute to the development and maintenance of reusable AI components, tools, and internal best practices.
- Collaborate with AI engineers and stakeholders in architecture reviews, testing, and knowledge-sharing activities.
- Ensure AI solutions align with governance, security, compliance, and responsible AI standards, including monitoring for quality, reliability, and potential bias.

What We’re Looking For

- Academic background in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
- Knowledge of AI and GenAI fundamentals, either through academic or professional work.
- Experience developing production-level solutions using Python and working with APIs, data pipelines, or AI frameworks.
- Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and modern AI development tools.
- Knowledge of Azure AI Services or other cloud-based AI platforms is a plus.
- Understanding of software development best practices and the AI solution lifecycle.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business challenges into practical solutions.
- Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Collaborative mindset with the ability to build effective working relationships across teams.
- Customer-focused approach and genuine interest in improving business outcomes through technology.
- Curious, proactive, and eager to learn new technologies in a fast-paced environment.
- Adaptable and comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities, and evolving business requirements.
- Strong organizational and time-management skills, with attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.
- Creative thinker with a passion for innovation, continuous improvement, and emerging AI technologies.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Join a company that believes in the added value of diversity, inclusion, and belonging. We foster a working environment in which all people are respected and valued, for all aspects which make them unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your true self to work every day!

Board International is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce.

jobs.description:
At Board, we power financial and operational planning solutions for the world’s best brands. Thousands of enterprises use our technology to optimize resources, drive growth, and ensure profitability. With advanced analytics and forecasting, plus AI-driven insights, customers transform complex, real-time data into actionable intelligence.

What’s been key to our success? Our people—we value everyone’s unique perspective and energy they bring to the organization. We collaborate openly across teams and borders. We embrace a growth mindset to get results. And we celebrate shared success as goals and milestones are achieved.

Ready to join a team where innovation meets collaboration? If you're driven by bold ideas and a customer-centric mentality, your next adventure starts here!

## Role Overview

We are seeking an

## FP&A Solution AI Developer

to help embed AI capabilities into our FP&A solution strategy and assets.

In this role, you will act as the primary resource for implementing AI use cases across FP&A solutions, working at the intersection of Board development, financial planning processes, and enterprise AI tools. You will help identify where AI can improve planning, forecasting, reporting, analysis, user guidance, automation, and decision support — then translate those opportunities into practical, scalable solution components.

We are looking for someone with an AI-centric mindset: curious, hands-on, and enthusiastic about using AI as a core part of how work gets done. You should be highly skilled in prompting, understand how to apply prompt engineering best practices, and be comfortable working with common enterprise LLM tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms.

This role is ideal for someone who can combine technical solution development, FP&A understanding, and AI experimentation to create reusable capabilities that can scale across customers and solution assets.

## Key Responsibilities

- Act as the primary developer for AI use cases across FP&A solution assets and customer-ready frameworks.
- Design, test, and implement AI-enabled features for planning, forecasting, reporting, analytics, insights, and user assistance.
- Translate FP&A business needs into practical AI use cases, prompts, workflows, and solution components.
- Develop and maintain prompt libraries, AI workflows, prototypes, demos, and reusable AI solution assets.
- Work with Product Owners, Solution Architects, FP&A experts, and developers to embed AI into existing solution frameworks.
- Test, validate, and refine AI outputs to ensure accuracy, relevance, usability, consistency, and business value.
- Document AI use cases, prompting logic, usage guidelines, limitations, and enablement materials for internal and customer-facing teams

## Required Skills

- Proven experience working with enterprise AI and LLM tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, or similar platforms.
- Excellent prompt engineering skills, including prompt design, testing, refinement, evaluation, and documentation. Ability to translate FP&A requirements into AI-enabled workflows, use cases, prototypes, and scalable solution components.
- Strong understanding of AI output validation, including accuracy checks, hallucination risk, context quality, and business relevance.
- Experience integrating AI into existing business, data, analytics, planning, or application frameworks.
- Ability to work independently, experiment quickly, and turn AI concepts into practical deliverables.

Preferred Skills

- Basic understanding of FP&A processes such as budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, management reporting, variance analysis, and scenario modelling.
- Experience working within an Enterprise Performance Management tools

jobs.description:
At Board, we power financial and operational planning solutions for the world’s best brands. Thousands of enterprises use our technology to optimize resources, drive growth, and ensure profitability. With advanced analytics and forecasting, plus AI-driven insights, customers transform complex, real-time data into actionable intelligence.  What’s been key to our success? Our people—we value everyone’s unique perspective and energy they bring to the organization. We collaborate openly across teams and borders. We embrace a growth mindset to get results. And we celebrate shared success as goals and milestones are achieved.  Ready to join a team where innovation meets collaboration? If you're driven by bold ideas and a customer-centric mentality, your next adventure starts here!  Role Overview  We are looking for a highly skilled  Product Owner – Integrated Business Planning (IBP)  to drive the technical delivery of our integrated solutions.   Working in close partnership with the Product Manager, you will play a critical role in translating product strategy into executable deliverables. While Product Managers define the vision, value proposition, and roadmap, you will ensure that this vision is technically feasible, well-structured, and effectively delivered.   You will act as the bridge between business requirements and technology, breaking down complex planning needs into clear, actionable workstreams. You will also challenge assumptions when needed, ensuring that solutions are aligned with platform capabilities, architectural standards, and scalable design principles.   This role requires strong organizational skills, technical acumen, and experience with enterprise planning platforms—ideally similar to Board.  Key Responsibilities

- Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring clarity, prioritization, and alignment with the product roadmap
- Translate high-level product strategy into detailed user stories, workflows, and technical requirements
- Assess and validate the technical feasibility of proposed solutions, challenging assumptions where necessary
- Break down complex IBP use cases into structured development workstreams
- Collaborate closely with Engineering teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions
- Ensure alignment between design, architecture, and platform capabilities
- Take ownership of the technical delivery and output quality of the development team
- Validate end-to-end workflows, ensuring consistency, usability, and performance
- Support cross-functional integration across: Financial Planning (FP&A) Commercial Planning Supply Chain Planning S&OP Workforce & Strategic Planning
- Financial Planning (FP&A)
- Commercial Planning
- Supply Chain Planning
- S&OP
- Workforce & Strategic Planning
- Contribute to solution design decisions, ensuring adherence to best practices and platform strengths
- Support customer-facing activities, including implementations, demos, and solution validation
- Stay up to date with trends in IBP, connected planning, and planning technologies

Required Skills & Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role in enterprise software or planning solutions
- Strong experience in Integrated Business Planning (IBP), S&OP or related domains
- Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications and deliverables
- Experience working with planning platforms (e.g., Board, Anaplan, SAP IBP, Oracle, or similar)
- Solid understanding of data models, workflows, and system design within planning solutions
- Experience working in Agile development environments
- Strong organizational and backlog management skills
- Ability to challenge and refine product requirements based on technical constraints and best practices
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Board platform or similar multidimensional planning technologies
- Background in consulting, transformation programs, or enterprise implementations
- Familiarity with enterprise-wide planning frameworks and architectures
- Exposure to AI-driven planning, forecasting, or scenario modeling

Why Join Us This role gives you the opportunity to shape how organizations plan and operate. Be part of a high-impact team that delivers market-ready, industry-leading solutions using Board’s intelligent planning platform.

Working as part of a collaborative team of developers, the core mission is to act as the bridge between the Product Owner and the technical build — translating functional requirements into robust, maintainable, and reliable technical solutions.

- Work closely with the Product Owner to translate functional and business requirements into clear, well-structured technical specifications that the development team can rely on.
- Design, build, and maintain applications on the Board platform, with FCR as the primary focus area.

- Own the quality and reliability of delivered solutions, including data integrity, performance, and maintainability.
- Support adjacent solution areas such as Lease Accounting and Tax Reporting, ensuring consistency across the wider platform.
- Document solution design, data flows, and configuration to support handover, audit, and future development.
- Collaborate closely with fellow developers, sharing knowledge and contributing to internal best practices and technical standards.

## Requirements

- Proven experience in solution development, with significant time spent building applications on the Board platform (data models, procedures, and reporting layers).
- Strong understanding of financial consolidation and reporting processes.
- Demonstrated ability to take requirements from a Product Owner and convert them into reliable technical requirements.
- Solid grasp of data modeling, integration concepts, and solution reliability.
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across both finance and technical teams as part of a development team
- A background in finance and accounting (degree or equivalent professional experience).
- Working knowledge of Lease Accounting (e.g., IFRS 16 / ASC 842) and its system implications.

jobs.title: UX Designer
jobs.description:
At Board, we help enterprises plan smarter, drive outcomes and lead transformation with one single Intelligent Planning Platform. Trusted by thousands of leading organizations, over the last 30 years we have designed our Product with enterprise planning agility in mind and the passionate care of our people as our main driver.

We strongly believe every colleague brings unique value to our whole. We collaborate openly and effectively to deliver results and celebrate our shared success, thrive on innovation, and embrace a growth mindset to aim higher every day.

If you’re a forward-thinker looking for the great next step in your career within an innovative and collaborative environment, Board is the right workplace for you!

We are looking for a passionate and innovative

## User Experience Designer (UX Designer)

to join our dynamic UX team. Reporting to the UX Lead, you will have the opportunity to influence product direction and drive innovation through your expertise in user-centered design.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, QA, Sales, and fellow designers to craft clear, effective, and user-centered experiences for complex enterprise workflows.

## Your responsibilities will include:

- Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to understand project goals and design requirements.
- Translating user needs, business goals, and technical requirements into clear, intuitive, and effective design solutions.
- Rapidly creating and iterating on designs using conceptual diagrams, wireframes, and interactive prototypes while ensuring the delivery of clear, detailed design specifications.
- Leveraging our pattern library to create designs and identifying opportunities to expand it by working closely with the UI infrastructure team.
